topic: CHEFMAN Qt Mini Air Fryer vs Chefman TurboFry Qt Air Fryer
angle: Head-to-head: which of these two is the smarter buy for most people?

reviews.title: CHEFMAN Qt Mini Air Fryer
pros: Genuinely small footprint — about 9.5 inches deep, fits under most upper cabinets and tucks into tight corners
Simple manual dials (time and temperature) with no digital menu maze — set it and walk away
Nonstick basket and tray pop out for quick hand-washing; no dishwasher-safe fuss

reviews.title: Chefman TurboFry Qt Air Fryer
pros: True 8-quart capacity fits a whole 5-pound chicken or 6-8 servings of fries without crowding
Dual independent baskets with separate temperature and timer controls let you cook two dishes at once
Dishwasher-safe parts and nonstick coating hold up well after months of heavy use
